END_IronHandGrenadier
Ironhand Grenadier is a summonable ally during Confront the Elder Brain if the party completes Avenge the Ironhands.

Involvement

Ironhand Grenadiers can be summoned with the  Gather Your Allies variant,  Ironhand Grenadiers, if the party completes ⁠Avenge the Ironhands by either siding with  Wulbren or by persuading  Barcus Wroot to take over leadership of the Ironhands.
